nca0d932925.headline: Pakistan Airlines suspends service to the US, reason Trump’s statement?
nca0d932925.summary: Pakistan International Airlines is reportedly preparing to suspend its flight services to the United States, possibly linked to recent political statements.
nca0d932925.why: Flight suspensions affect airline revenues and bilateral trade and travel relations, impacting the aviation sector and broader economic ties between countries.
